title: Price terciles for products
prompt: Return product, price, and price_tier — split all products into 3 roughly equal-sized groups by price ascending using NTILE(3), where tier 1 contains the cheapest products. Use a window function.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE products_price (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product TEXT, price REAL); INSERT INTO products_price VALUES (1,'Widget',9.99),(2,'Gadget',19.99),(3,'Gizmo',5.49),(4,'Doohickey',29.99),(5,'Thingamajig',14.99),(6,'Contraption',3.99),(7,'Apparatus',24.99),(8,'Mechanism',12.49),(9,'Device',7.99);
reference_sql: SELECT product, price, NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY price ASC) AS price_tier FROM products_price;
